playReplacementMode.note: This app has one Play subscription; plan changes are base-plan switches within it. Google Play allows only CHARGE_FULL_PRICE or WITHOUT_PRORATION for those (any other mode fails), and a regular purchase applies the Play Console default (Charge immediately / Charge at the next billing date). The app passes no replacement mode, so the billing terms are that Play Console setting.
